narrative.overview:
Algo-Visual is a study surface: a lacquer shell over a bone page, with cinnabar as the only accent. The accent fills the midpoint and the measured span, and it fills the one primary button. The same red marks whatever is current: the nav underline, the code-line number, the trace index, the caret, and the focus ring. Low and high stay ink. A cell outside the range drops to one quiet tone.

Chinese is the primary line. Noto Serif SC carries the brand, the page title, and the section titles. Noto Sans SC carries the UI, including the English line set under each serif title. JetBrains Mono is loaded for the code block and for nothing else. The page is one left-aligned column. Reading text holds to 68ch. The array is the working object, and the status sentence and the buttons sit directly under it.

The material is flat. Depth is the lacquer bar on bone, raised bone on the cells and the code block, and hairline rules between list rows. Corners stay short. The signature is the span: a cinnabar bar with end ticks, positioned from the live low and high cell boxes, easing closed when a bound moves. prefers-reduced-motion cuts that transition. The name is set in the serif. There is no logo and no cast shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Lacquer header, bone page, cinnabar as the only accent
Serif Chinese titles, sans UI, mono kept inside the code block
Low and high marks in ink; discarded cells in one quiet tone
A span measured from the live cell boxes
Flat surfaces, hairline rules, inset marks for the current item and the target
One filled button, with reset as a ghost

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Cinnabar is the only accent. It fills the midpoint, the span, and the primary button, and it marks the current nav underline, the current code-line number, keyword tokens, the trace index, the caret, and the focus ring. Low and high marks stay ink. The code-line wash and text selection are tints of the same red, not new hues.

rules.name: The Shared Pigment Rule
rules.body: Lacquer and ink are one value. The header, the disabled primary, body text, and the low and high marks all use it. A second near-black does not belong.

rules.name: The Quiet Discard Rule
rules.body: A cell outside the live range loses its fill and its border and is set in quiet ink. It does not take a hue of its own.

rules.name: The Serif Title Rule
rules.body: Noto Serif SC is the brand, the Chinese page title, and section titles. The English line paired with each of those is Noto Sans SC in soft ink. The rest of the UI is the sans.

rules.name: The Mono Fence Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only inside the code block. Cell figures, the step count, bounds, and trace indexes use the sans with tabular numbers.

rules.name: The Single Column Rule
rules.body: One left-aligned column, `min(1120px, calc(100% - 48px))`, with reading text at 68ch. The lacquer header is the only full-bleed band.

rules.name: The Flat Mark Rule
rules.body: No cast shadow. Depth is lacquer on bone, raised bone on cells and code, and the cinnabar wash on the current code line. Inset rules mark the current nav item and the target cell. Hover lifts a cell by 2px and does not grow a shadow.

rules.name: The Short Corner Rule
rules.body: Radius stays at 2px on the span and the legend swatches, 3px on cells, and 4px on buttons and the code block. Cells are squares.

rules.name: The Measured Span Rule
rules.body: Left, width, and top come from the low and high cell boxes: left at the low cell's left, width through the high cell's right, top 8px below the cell bottom. Those three ease over 520ms with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). prefers-reduced-motion removes the transition.

rules.name: The Single Primary Rule
rules.body: The step action is the one filled cinnabar button. Reset is the ghost. The found state keeps the button and disables it to lacquer. Below 720px both buttons are full width and 48px tall.

dos: Do keep the page bone and the app header lacquer, and use that same value for ink.
Do fill the midpoint and the measured span with cinnabar, and keep the low and high marks in ink.
Do clear the fill and the border of a discarded cell and set its figure in quiet ink.
Do position the span from the live cell boxes, 8px below the cell bottom, and ease left, width, and top over 520ms unless reduced motion is requested.
Do set Chinese titles in Noto Serif SC and the UI in Noto Sans SC, and keep JetBrains Mono inside the code block.
Do use one filled cinnabar button for the step and a ghost button for reset.
Do draw focus as a 2px outline offset 3px, cinnabar on bone and bone on the lacquer header.
donts: Don't add an accent that is not cinnabar or a wash of it.
Don't paint the low or high marks in cinnabar.
Don't give a discarded cell a fill, a border, or a hue of its own.
Don't cast a drop shadow. Inset rules are reserved for the current nav item and the target ring.
Don't set interface text, figures, or counts in JetBrains Mono.
Don't place a second filled button beside the primary.
Don't size the span from a column index. It follows the measured cell boxes.
